ownerStatement: Approved by repeat98 on 27 Oct 2026 in the issue-fix session ("approved"): release POLY8 0.3.2-experimental so its machine list scrolls on card builds (#842, #941, #942).
reason: 0.3.2 changes only POLY8's card-build machine chooser: with POLY8 beside VECTOR, FM Synth or Analog BD the double-tap TRACK list has seven to nine rows, but stock drew the six visible rows from the top of the list whatever its scroll offset and its UP/DOWN handlers clamp the cursor to row 5, so the seventh machine never showed and could not be picked. Names (a pointer at 0x4007865e to mr_chooser_name) and the track's mark (mr_chooser_row) now read top + screen row, as the USB base's registry does since #922, and the five cursor clamps are composition count sites (card only; POLY8 alone writes stock's value). The render, the voice limit and the pages are 0.3.1's, so the 0.2.7 captures are retained; the USB package rebuilds byte-identical and stays at 0.3.1 (lagsBehind). Checked in ot_emu with card builds of POLY8 + VECTOR + FM Synth (+ Analog BD), POLY8 alone and VECTOR alone. Waived for this exact source: the card build on a unit, Part/project reload and power cycles, chip worst-case cycles and complete memory bounds.
